title: Shift compatibility of strict-system realization maps
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$. Let $W$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme with its small pro-etale site, put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$, and let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves with derived reduction $\mathcal R_W$ and total-limit functor $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$. Restrict to normalized systems with compatible etale-origin witnesses, bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude in common finite intervals. For a finite well-typed expression $V$ in the system pullback, system direct image, open extension and derived tensor, with derived-complete constructible integral inputs $K_1,\ldots,K_s$ and all intermediate objects in those bounds, let $c_V:\mathcal L_WV(\mathcal R K_1,\ldots,\mathcal R K_s)\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{\mathrm{int}}(K_1,\ldots,K_s)$ be the canonical realization isomorphism of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Equip both sides with their canonical integer-shift comparisons induced by termwise cochain shift and completed integral shift. For every $r\in\mathbf Z$, the realization square commutes: the integral shift comparison after $c_V$ equals $c_V$ after the system shift comparison. The same assertion holds after whiskering by any such expression and for every canonical system map (units, counits, pullback/tensor maps, direct-image compositors, proper/open interchange and projection maps) together with its corresponding integral map. In particular, for a compactification $f=pj$, the realization for $V=S_pJ_j$ identifies $\mathcal L_W(S_pJ_j)(\mathcal R K)$ with the integral compact-support object $Rf_!K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{!,n}K_n$ of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and this identification commutes with every integer shift.
